com.fourtwenty.building.dispensary.desc: The Budtender crafts joints from weed buds and paper and serves eligible adult colonists.
fourtwenty.dispensary.unavailable: I could not get a joint at the dispensary. I will try again later.
com.minecolonies.coremod.gui.townhall.ha: Smoking a joint brings a small happiness benefit. Pending demand has a grace period; prolonged unmet demand slightly reduces happiness.
Hanging out near a burning bong lifts the mood for a while afterwards.
fourtwenty.dispensary.happiness.satisfie: I have smoked a joint and feel content. This gives a small happiness benefit until my next joint is due.
fourtwenty.dispensary.happiness.grace.de: I would like a joint. I am still within the grace period, so this does not affect my happiness yet.
fourtwenty.dispensary.happiness.unmet.de: I have waited beyond the grace period for a joint. This slightly reduces my happiness; I will keep working and try again later.
fourtwenty.dispensary.happiness.ineligib: Only adults assigned to a completed level 3 or higher residence have cannabis demand.
fourtwenty.dispensary.status.title: Dispensary service
fourtwenty.dispensary.status.condition.u: Hire a Budtender in the worker tab.
fourtwenty.dispensary.status.condition.a: Budtender is away from the counter.
fourtwenty.dispensary.status.condition.p: Production needs two paper per joint.
fourtwenty.dispensary.status.condition.e: No joints available at the counter.
